findings.evidence: The two panels are reported separately. No combined-panel or unmeasured subgroup conclusion is made. Within-panel hidden subgroup heterogeneity is not ruled out by the pooled estimates.

Pooled acceptance is defined from summed token/call counts; request wins, regressions and ties are shown separately. The report does not infer token-level repair or forgetting from aggregate count changes.
All requests from the original fixed, exposure-audited panels are retained. No favorable outcome filtering occurs. Inference remains conditional on these eligible MathQA inputs and fixed checkpoints.

No adjustment, stratification, or exclusion is introduced based on output lengths, acceptance, or success. Caps remain in the estimates. Runtime/card comparability uses prior qualification, not outcome-conditioned filtering.
Both panel denominators are 256. Gross calls saved and added, request regressions and ties, EOS/cap counts, and zero-call counts are visible; the result is not framed as all requests benefiting.

Inputs were sealed before generation and are not selected because origin or endpoint scores were extreme. The new origin contrasts are explicitly retrospective; they do not establish additional-training-seed robustness.
Both complete panels and every endpoint repeat validate. No missing, capped, zero-call, or unfavorable request is discarded. An incomplete evidence set would make that contrast unavailable.

All five handoff-requested origin contrasts are reported, with original draw seeds and no new model run. Intervals are explicitly retrospective and pointwise, not simultaneous or multiplicity-adjusted; there is no paper-wide familywise claim.

The fixed request sets, metric semantics, original paired draws and linear quantiles are preserved. The reader metadata repair and timer-wrapper startup failure remain documented. No alternative output-dependent analysis was selected.

Same-input checkpoint comparisons support the stated fixed-trajectory count improvement. C/origin is not attributed to allocation: C/N remains the relevant incremental contrast, and C/N preservation is unresolved. No serving speedup versus origin is claimed.

The origin precedes adaptation, and fixed endpoint checkpoints were created before the new retrospective reduction. The report does not infer a causal token-level mechanism or a future algorithm from the observed endpoint association.

statistical_caution: Pointwise, retrospective, request-resampling uncertainty; small effects and fixed/shared trained endpoints. No training-seed or universal nondegradation claim.
independence: Separate raw/count/statistic implementation, performed before viewing final reducer numbers; same project context and overlapping historical implementation authorship. Not blinded experimental replication.
